proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report disclosing Chevron's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association and ALEC-type memberships, and oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because the Board believes that a special report beyond Chevron's current voluntary and mandatory disclosures is an unnecessary and inefficient use of Chevron's resources.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Targets for Reducing Greenhouse Gas Emissions
proposals.topic_summary: Requests adoption of long-term, quantitative, company-wide greenhouse gas reduction targets for products and operations consistent with 2°C goal, and a report by November 30, 2016.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal. Chevron complies with the laws and regulations of the countries in which we operate

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Climate Change Impact Assessment
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual assessment of long-term portfolio impacts to 2035 of possible climate policies, including IEA 450 scenario, on reserves and capital planning.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because such a report is unnecessary in light of the safeguards and oversight in place

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Reserve Replacements
proposals.topic_summary: Requests reporting of reserve replacements in BTU energy units by resource category, annually, in addition to SEC reserve reporting.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because Chevron's reserve reporting is in accordance with U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) rules

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Dividend Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Requests advisory commitment to increase total capital distributions (dividends and buybacks) to shareholders in light of stranded carbon asset risks.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because it believes that the proposed dividend policy is both unnecessary and unwise.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Shale Energy Operations
proposals.topic_summary: Requests quantitative reporting on all shale plays on water use, recycling, groundwater, closed-loop systems, and community impacts from hydraulic fracturing.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because Chevron has in place well-developed risk management systems

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Independent Director with Environmental Expertise
proposals.topic_summary: Requests that at least one board nominee have environmental expertise in hydrocarbon exploration and production and qualify as independent director.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because the Board believes that its current membership possesses significant environmental experience

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Special Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Requests bylaw amendment giving holders of 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowners meeting.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because stockholders have consistently supported Chevron's current By-Law regarding special meetings
